name: VividSites
tagline: Cinematic website templates, build prompts and UI/3D component code. Paid account required.
description: Search templates, inspect previews, retrieve complete build prompts, and get editable UI or 3D component code. All six tools require a personal VividSites API key and an active paid library account. The connector supplies library assets; it does not run VividSites Create builds, publish sites, purchase credits or initiate payments. OAuth is not implemented. Premium build-prompt retrieval can consume the account's existing daily library allowance. The MIT license covers the connector configuration, not catalog assets or paid service access.

install.notes: Replace the literal key placeholder privately using Cline's credential/configuration controls. Do not paste credentials in model chats, shared files, URLs, or shell history. Prefer the repository's llms-install.md private-configuration guide. Keep tool approvals enabled. A paid VividSites library account and a separately authenticated Cline model provider are required. Published October 14 evidence covers the Cline SDK; the current native CLI/IDE install command has not been runtime-verified.
